R-SOURCE.hypotheses: exact module, revision, source, declaration, and type digests
R-SOURCE.inference: resolve the qualified declaration in the pinned environment
R-SOURCE.exceptional_cases: substituted imports and unqualified capture are rejected
R-SOURCE.trust_boundary: provider statement bytes plus independent dependency audit

R-SEMANTIC.hypotheses: pinned source declaration and fully qualified target header
R-SEMANTIC.inference: elaborate both and compare root expressions
R-SEMANTIC.output: one expression digest and transitive constant census
R-SEMANTIC.exceptional_cases: shadowing, parser changes, aliases, coercions, and import substitution fail
R-SEMANTIC.trust_boundary: trust-zero elaboration followed by Master recomputation

R-FORWARD.hypotheses: a proof of the elaborated source proposition
R-FORWARD.inference: pass the proof through the expression identity
R-FORWARD.output: a proof of the target proposition
R-FORWARD.exceptional_cases: no hidden rewrite or semantic conversion

R-REVERSE.hypotheses: a proof of the elaborated target proposition
R-REVERSE.inference: apply the separately declared inverse identity
R-REVERSE.output: a proof of the source proposition
R-REVERSE.exceptional_cases: reverse coverage is explicit rather than inferred from prose

R-ROOT.hypotheses: pinned provider declaration and forward transport
R-ROOT.inference: instantiate the transport at the provider proof
R-ROOT.output: the unconditional exact target lower bound
R-ROOT.exceptional_cases: extra assumptions, weaker conclusions, and alternate exponents fail
R-ROOT.trust_boundary: kernel replay plus dependency and axiom audit

R-AUDIT.hypotheses: both transports, exact root, anchors, and frozen command
R-AUDIT.inference: cold replay and semantic/deletion mutation checks
R-AUDIT.output: empty cut sets and a current validation trace
R-AUDIT.exceptional_cases: stale objects and semantic substitutions fail closed
R-AUDIT.trust_boundary: worker proposes and canonical Master alone accepts

reviewers.role: hypothesis, inference, output, and exception preservation review
